title: Set script device preset
description: Install an android, iphone, ipad or desktop script device preset on an agent-owned page and re-apply it after main-document navigation. Pair with dsagent.page.viewport.set for responsive layout testing.
guidance: This changes script-visible navigator properties only: network headers, browser engine, native touch and actual device pixel ratio remain unchanged. State lasts until clear, tab closure or Extension restart. Applied reports current-document verification; false means it is installed for later navigation but not verified now. No arbitrary user-agent string, script, geolocation or browser protocol command is accepted. Requires an idempotency key.
